purpose: Local registry and public parcel-geometry source review. Queries were separated by English and local language. No owner, address, tax, or private property fields were queried or retained.
assessment: Official Guangxi Natural Resources reporting states Yulin Natural Resources Bureau convened the 2024 citywide rural real-estate registration meeting and directed registration database work. Guangxi’s official registered-property “map inquiry” service requires identity authentication and can return parcel/building attributes; this was not accessed. The National Geo-information Portal is an official map platform, but no anonymous Yulin parcel geometry schema or response was verified. No full polygon was returned; geometry presence remains unverified.
